build_task_template: build a PHyRE task template that places a bar on an obstacle and requires knocking it off
create_obstacle_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width and x position on a platform
create_dynamic_bar: create a vertical dynamic bar balanced on top of the obstacle
define_task_relationships: define the task goal as the dynamic bar touching the bottom wall
configure_search_params: configure search parameters to require stable ball solutions and exclude trivial ones
